title: Personal OKRs - weekly check-in (Camila Rivera) - 2026-03-31
content:
Week: 2026-03-31 weekly check-in
Owner: Camila Rivera (eng-serving-runtime)
Status: Draft personal notes / scratchpad

Quick summary
- Focus this week: landing q2 perf work (inference batching + kernel selection heuristics), ramping experiments for p50/p99 latency reduction, and mentoring new SWE on KV cache flow.
- Overall progress: on-track for the milestone but blocked by one infrastructure quota issue that slowed end-to-end validation runs.

OKR context (Q2 personal objectives)
Objective 1: Improve real-world inference latency and throughput for high-concurrency workloads\- KR1: Reduce p50 end-to-end generation latency for 512-token sequences on xG GPUs by 15% vs baseline (baseline = 240ms)\- KR2: Increase throughput (tokens/s) for our 4-node dedicated pools by 25% under 95th percentile load pattern\- KR3: Deliver canary rollout of continuous-batching heuristic + autoscaler config to 10 internal customers

This week - progress against KRs
- KR1: Microbenchmarks show ~10% improvement with new fused attention kernel on 512 context; full E2E test (with I/O + pre/post processing) still shows ~6-7% improvement.
  - Done: landed kernel selection change in PR #789 (linked).
  - TODO: run full E2E validation with traffic replay (blocked, see infra).
- KR2: Batch sizing changes + improved batching window reduced per-token overhead; internal sim shows +18% tokens/s for target workload.
  - Need: final smoke tests on dedicated pool (waiting on quota bump).
- KR3: Draft rollout playbook done, targeted customers list prepared (10 teams). Canary plan ready pending E2E results.

Blockers / Risks
- Infra quota (cluster autoscale / ephemeral queue) limited my ability to run full validation runs yesterday; SRE ticket JIRA-4321 raised. ETA for resolution: 48-72h depending on infra team's schedule.
- Regression risk: some non-deterministic latency spikes in the 99th percentile when batch sizes exceed 64 for short sequences. Need better instrumentation to root cause (is it GC in preproc? KV cache throttling?).
- Availability of test GPUs for overnight runs (other teams are running long experiments). Planning to schedule time slots with infra.

Action items / next week plan
- High priority: get infra quota resolved and run full E2E validation with traffic replay (acceptance criteria: end-to-end p50 reduction >=12% and no p99 regression >5%).
- Follow up with SRE on scheduling dedicated nightly runs and reserve two testing windows (Mon/Tue 2am-6am PT).
- Add more detailed latency-tagging in the tracing spans (client->preproc->inference->postproc) to isolate p99 spikes.
- Pair with new SWE (Ravi) to transfer knowledge on shard-level batching heuristics; plan two pairing sessions next week.
- Prepare canary rollout email + rollback checklist for product owners (Priya to review).

Notes to self (scratchpad)
- Consider short-term fallback: enable smaller batch cap for short sequences while preserving batching ramp for long sequences. Might reduce peak tokens/s but smooth p99.
- Revisit caching TTL for prefix cache; current heuristics may be evicting too aggressively under bursty traffic.
- Check PR #789 comments from infra-reviewer (there was a note about thread-pool sizing).

Questions / decisions to make
- If p99 spikes continue after tracing improvements, do we: (A) throttle batching for short sequences, (B) increase CPU workers for preproc, or (C) instrument and delay larger rollouts? Leaning toward (A) + (C) as immediate mitigations.
- Can we request a temporary quota increase for testing only (2 weeks) vs permanent change? Will ask SRE and document scope in JIRA-4321.

Quick metric snapshot (from internal dashboard - rough, needs refresh)
- Baseline p50 (512 tokens): 240ms -> current canary: ~220ms microbench, E2E: ~225ms
- p99 baseline: 520ms -> current: ~540ms (spikes observed)
- Tokens/s (4-node): baseline 12k -> sim: 14.2k (+18%)

Meeting / sync notes
- 2026-03-30 sync with Priya: reviewed canary plan, agreed to hold off customer-facing canary until E2E passes.
- 2026-03-31 pairing with Ravi: walked through batching code and KV cache; assigned follow-ups for better metrics emission.

Links / references
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/789
- Jira: JIRA-4321 (infra quota for test clusters)
- Playbook draft: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/987654321/Throughput+Improvement+Plan

Reflection / personal notes
- Felt productive pairing with Ravi; knowledge transfer is going well but I need to carve out dedicated time for deep-dive debugging.
- Keep communication tight with SRE - infra constraints are the biggest pacing factor for hitting KRs this quarter.
